summary: Golub Capital Private Income Fund S filed an 8-K reporting routine unregistered sales of 2,068 common shares at $24.18 NAV per share (proceeds $50,000), a declared monthly distribution of $0.1667 gross per share (net $0.1492), and standard portfolio commentary as of July 31, 2026 (165 companies, $249 million fair value, 98% first-lien). No special-situation event—this is ordinary BDC operational disclosure—sales under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S, distribution record date August 31, payment September 29. No deal terms, no strategic action.
